definition: the taste of food in your mouth
description: A street-food market at night lit by paper lanterns under brick arches. A young woman in a black leather jacket takes a big bite of a folded taco, eyes shut and head tilted back with pleasure, and keeps chewing happily. Two friends beside her bite into their own tacos. Small bowls of red and green salsa and lime wedges stand on the long wooden table, and behind them a cook in a red cap turns tortillas on a hot griddle at a stall, then folds his arms.

taps.phrase: to dig in with a fork
